def: properly, tightly girt, i.e. probably a racer, or some fleet animal (as being slender in the waist)

occurrences.text: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
